name: Kael'thas: the Phoenix burns 2% per second, not 7% (COA-6781)
contract: Phoenix 21362 puts Burn 36720 on itself when it spawns. CoA's Burn deals 2% of the Phoenix's health every second, so 6 seconds after Burn it still has more than 80% health. spell_kaelthas_burn no longer adds another 5% per tick.

steps.label: the Phoenix loses about 2% per second
